status: prospective runtime seed binding; no fits/numerical execution
controlled_generator_device: current activation CUDA device; persistent throughout each acquisition
native_FFN_streams: Snapshot actual post-constructor global CPU/CUDA RNG state into persistent body scopes. Restore/capture at body boundaries, never reseed each update. Shared routes use the single shared-body native stream.
original_sequential: retain actual native global RNG stream; do not replace/burn/replay its draws
matched_initialization: same-model arm constructors use identical seeds and constructor order. Controls may differ structurally as declared. No claim of matching original vs wrapper stochastic trajectories.
readiness_seed: seed namespace identical to first pilot block; readiness states are discarded and fresh fits start again from declared constructors
